executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM/RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the most stressed areas. The Daily Check on 2026-08-19 reviewed eight relevant items; there is no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will only reach the market with a lag. For buyers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain critical.
